title: rostraria cristata
intro: Rostraria cristata, commonly known as Bristle Bent Grass, is a perennial plant species in the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rostraria cristata include its bronchodilatory and mucolytic effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of asthma and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
